brandMeaning: PerAnt is Personal Agent shortened and a transformation of Parent: a family-like companion who works alongside the user.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production mascot cutout for the PerAnt personal agent mobile app. Create ONE original character, full body, centered, with a genuinely transparent alpha background. No collage, no text, no watermark, no labels.
Brand meaning: PerAnt is both "Personal Agent" shortened and a playful transformation of "Parent". This is a caring family-like companion who sits beside you while you work, kind and capable rather than a boss or authority figure. Friendly to adults, charming and reassuring, not a baby toy.
Subject design: a very cute small anthropomorphic ant-inspired creature in premium tactile 3D soft plush / wool-felt illustration. A big rounded creamy face surrounded by a soft moss-sage green fuzzy head, exactly two short curved antennae with rounded tips, tiny dark glossy oval eyes with subtle highlights, a gentle small smile, a hint of warm peach blush. A small pear-shaped plush body, soft mitten hands and stubby feet. Not realistic insect anatomy, no mandibles, no extra insect legs. Short cozy oatmeal knitted neckerchief/scarf. A small sage belly pocket bears seven tiny cream embroidered dots arranged like the PerAnt seven-dot mark. Original, distinctive character identity, no resemblance to existing famous mascots.
Pose: warm welcome, standing with one little hand lifted in a gentle hello and the other resting comfortably by its pocket. Open, relaxed body language, slightly tilted head. No laptop or extra props in this base asset.
Art direction: beautifully crafted high-end soft 3D storybook character render, pleasing rounded silhouette, fine short felt fibers, matte tactile surface, soft diffused daylight from upper left, subtle dimensional shading, no plastic shine, no harsh outlines, no glossy toy look. A limited palette of warm cream, desaturated sage green and tiny peach accents. Camera at the character's eye level, nearly front facing with a slight 3/4 turn. Full antennae and feet visible, ample clean transparent padding on all sides. Character occupies around 75-80 percent of the square frame. No floor, no background color, no furniture, no cast ground shadow. The character must read beautifully at 140px and still have carefully resolved detail at large size.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied PerAnt plush ant mascot into a WORKING pose. Keep this exact same character identity, face proportions, antennae, cream face, sage felt material, oatmeal knitted neckerchief and pocket. It is our family-like work companion. Full body centered, seated comfortably behind a tiny warm-cream laptop with sage accents, looking at the screen with a calm focused small smile, both mitten hands naturally typing. The face remains clearly visible above the laptop. The laptop has NO text, letters or logos. Preserve the premium soft tactile 3D felt render style and delicate fibers, soft upper-left daylight. Keep the pocket's tiny embroidered dot motif. Transparent alpha background, no room, no floor, no cast ground shadow, no text or watermark. Match the base character scale and eye-level front 3/4 camera, full antennae and feet entirely within frame. Ample padding.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied PerAnt plush ant mascot into a QUIET BREAK pose. Keep this exact same character identity, face proportions, antennae, cream face, sage felt material, oatmeal knitted neckerchief and pocket. The character sits comfortably, holding a small simple warm cream ceramic mug with both little mitten hands close to the belly. Eyes gently relaxed, small soft smile, looking peaceful and companionable like sitting beside a family member at a desk. No steam, food, laptop or other props. Preserve the premium soft tactile 3D felt render style, delicate fibers and soft upper-left daylight. Keep the embroidered pocket dot motif visible if possible. Transparent alpha background, no background scenery, no floor, no cast ground shadow, no text or watermark. Full antennae and feet entirely within frame, generous clean padding. Match base character size and eye-level camera.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied PerAnt plush ant mascot into a gentle HIGH-FIVE / TASK COMPLETE pose. Keep the exact same character identity, head and body proportions, antennae, cream face, sage felt material, oatmeal knitted neckerchief and pocket. One little mitten hand is raised toward the viewer for a friendly high-five, other hand holds a small cream paper/document with a single simple sage checkmark and NO text. Eyes are cheerful gently curved smile eyes, mouth smiles softly, no huge open mouth. Feet comfortably standing, affectionate but understated joy, like sharing a small completed task with someone at home. Preserve soft tactile premium 3D felt rendering, delicate fibers, soft upper-left daylight, and the tiny embroidered pocket dot motif. Transparent alpha background, no confetti, no hearts, no floor or cast ground shadow, no text or watermark. Full body centered, antennae and feet within frame, ample padding. Match base camera and scale.
